links.outcome: External validation of MMAI prognostic association with BCR and adverse pathology in a Swedish RP cohort
links.effect: MMAI associated with BCR (sHR 2.45; 95% CI 1.77-3.38; P<0.001) and adverse pathology (OR 4.85; 95% CI 2.54-10.78; P<0.001); 5-year BCR 25% intermediate-high vs 4% low.
links.quote: MMAI was significantly associated with BCR [subdistribution HR, 2.45; 95% confidence interval (CI), 1.77-3.38; P < 0.001] and AP at RP (OR, 4.85; 95% CI, 2.54-10.78; P < 0.001).

screen.reason: This is an external validation of an AI biomarker (using digital pathology and clinical data) on an independent cohort, evaluating its prognostic accuracy without testing specific implementation or deployment practices.
